title: Project generator
objective: create-project command: copies the app skeleton, initialises ai-project-template protocol via ai-init --target, selects profile/modules, writes architecture block and confirmed validation commands, inherits ADRs, git init, validation, optional dev start. Interactive and non-interactive.
acceptance_criteria: create-project demo --profile core --no-start produces a project whose ./dev check passes
validation: python3 -m unittest scripts tests for generator
